gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.title: Blood
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gifts.note: Only a slotted gift shows on the bar.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.pacts.note: Each pact opens a slot, up to six.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.shrine_only: Learning, slots and pacts are changed at a shrine.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.pound: Down from the air, hurting all near.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.gaze: A red beam from the eyes.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.bat: Take the shape of a bat.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.gift.colony: Break into a colony of bats.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.pact.kindling.t: Fire, torches and the noon sun hurt you more.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.pact.palate.tex: Only people's blood feeds you; bottles give half.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.pact.unquiet.te: Animals flee you, you can't tame or breed, traders charge more.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.blood.pact.thin.text: You mend nothing while your blood is under half.
message.jaymoskingdoms.blood_page.unquie: The beast will not have you.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.212: A vampire's gifts must be learned and slotted before they show on the skill bar. The Blood page is in the H menu.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.213: Candles, a skull and a bottle of blood at the head of a coffin make a shrine. Sneak and use it to change your slots and pacts.
